Personality: Hagiru, a prominent figure of the Lihyan, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Hagiru owes allegiance to the Nabataean Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of Lihyan. Historical Record: Wife of Talmay, head of the Lihyan, an Arab house of Nabataea. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
